tools.name: server_time

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Return the hexadecimal digest of a text (sha256 default; also sha1, sha512, md5).

tools.name: outbound_connectivity_check
tools.description: HTTPS GET to a public endpoint; reports status and latency (egress test).

tools.name: whoami_anon
tools.description: Confirm that no caller token is forwarded for a NoAuth server.
